signatures.name: above_chance_discrimination
signatures.description: Hit rate (correctly flagging phishing) is significantly higher than false-alarm rate (flagging legitimate as phishing). The headline signature of phishing detection ability.

signatures.name: learning_effect
signatures.description: Accuracy on the 10 post-training trials is significantly higher than on the 10 pre-training trials. Singh et al.'s primary finding: outcome feedback during the training block improves classification on the held-out post-training set.

signatures.name: above_chance_overall
signatures.description: Overall accuracy across all 60 trials is significantly above 0.5 (chance).

signatures.name: practice_rt_speedup
signatures.description: Response time falls across trials within a phase as the classification task becomes familiar.
